name: Lighthouse Fund
subtitle: All-or-nothing crowdfund
description: Example 12 — fixed goal and deadline: permissionless one-shot payout on success, self-claim refunds that erase contributor state on failure.
long_description: A single-purpose crowdfunding contract with no middle outcome. Contributors send native funds until the goal scalar is reached or the deadline passes. If the goal is met — even before the deadline — anyone may trigger the single payout to the fixed beneficiary; overfunding in the final contribution is accepted in full as a donation. If the deadline passes below the goal, every contributor self-claims an exact refund, and each refund deletes that contributor's slot: a failed campaign converges to zero permanent state, while a successful one keeps contributor slots as proof-of-origin treasury accounting. Goal, deadline, and beneficiary are immutable at deploy time — no key can change the rules of a running campaign.

interface.description: Returns the constant identifier that marks a personal-test deployment policy.
Returns the address that receives the funds if the goal is reached.
Returns the guardian address that alone may engage the emergency brake, fixed at deployment.
Returns the brake specification URI and its document hash.
Returns the current brake state (0 normal, 1 new entries blocked, 2 fully paused), the guardian and the time it was engaged.
Returns the total raised so far and whether the funds were already withdrawn.
Lets a personal-test token notify this contract of a receipt so the token holding cap is checked; reverts if the cap is exceeded.
Contributes the attached native coin to the campaign; rejected after the deadline, once the goal is met, or while the brake blocks entries.
Returns the amount in wei an address has contributed and not yet had refunded.
Returns the campaign deadline as a Unix timestamp.
Raises the emergency brake to a higher state (1 blocks new entries, 2 pauses more); callable only by the guardian and cannot be lowered.
Returns the funding goal in wei.
Returns 'personal-test' if deployed under a personal-test policy, otherwise 'testnet'.
Returns whether an account is on this instance's personal-test allow list.
Returns the deployment authority address that vouches for related personal-test instances, or zero when not in personal-test mode.
Returns whether this instance runs under a personal-test policy that limits callers and held value.
Returns the maximum native coin balance this instance may hold in personal-test mode, or zero otherwise.
Returns the owner account of the personal-test policy, or zero when not in personal-test mode.
Returns the personal-test policy tuple: marker, owner, native coin cap and token cap.
Returns the maximum total raw token units this instance may hold in personal-test mode, or zero otherwise.
Returns the caller's whole contribution if the deadline passed and the goal was not reached.
Adds or removes an account on the personal-test allow list; callable only by the policy owner, who cannot be removed.
Returns the campaign state: 0 open, 1 goal reached, 2 failed, 3 reached and withdrawn.
Sends all raised funds to the beneficiary once the goal is reached; anyone may call it.
